notes.title: Patch 1.11 - Infinite Mode Balancing
notes.notes:
This is a quick balancing updated intended to keep Infinite Mode runs from lasting upwards of an hour. Enemy health, damage, and speed scaling were heavily adjusted to achieve this.

The amount and size of particles was also reduced. You should see better performance in later Infinite rounds (if you can reach them!).

Additional Patch Notes:
- fixed rare sun paladin crash when trying to heal a robot
- scattershot left and right shots angled a bit
- robot projectiles now scale down a bit when many projectiles are on screen

notes.title: Patch 1.101
notes.notes:
- can now access mods menu when store is open
- increased time between rounds in infinite mode
- fixed purchasing a hack mod from the store sometimes causing a crash (thanks jcnest10)
- fixed chainheal rare crash by adding extra instance checks for the robots that are being healed (thanks kantal)

notes.title: The Infinite Update
notes.notes:
Introducing Mechanibot's first major free update: INFINITE. With Infinite comes the highly requested endless mode and an entirely new class of robots called the mechanics! It also includes tons of balancing updates, fixes, and features. Check out the full patch notes below.

[h3]Infinite Mode[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eIVISs1.gif[/img]
The new Infinite Mode allows you to build your team beyond its normal limits and survive as long as you are able. The longer you stay alive, the larger your team can get and the more item effects you can stack. It also plays a lot faster. There are no pauses between rounds in Infinite Mode, enemy waves continue to spawn until they finally overtake you.

It's important to note that you cannot unlock new solar levels through Infinite Mode, and you will also not be able to progress through the main story and fully defy your fate.

Infinite mode is unlocked by defeating the final boss one (1) time.


[h3]We Can Fix It[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623014/4b9a27493999cc3dcc8a1e14fb8ed703d31d6aa6.png[/img]
This update also comes with five new robots, all members of the brand new mechanics class. The mechanic robots help you keep your team alive by healing them, shielding them, and redirecting enemy attacks. Usually while also doing a bit of damage of their own.

These little friends should help a lot with your team's suvivability and I'm excited to see what new comps people come up with!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ASgiXdv.gif[/img]

[h3]Full Patch Notes[/h3]
- Infinite Mode introduced
- Three new achievements added
- Solar Level 6 added
- Five new mechanic robots added
- robot gallery widened to accomodate new robots
- two new items added:
[list]
[*] Blast Resistant: Crystal Mines deal -50% damage to robots.
[*] Renewing Gear: Healing done by Mechanic robots is increased by +100%.
[/list]
- Hack Chests have a small chance to appear in the store in later rounds
- Scorcher class effect and Burning Bullets item effect now apply to all attacks, rather than only projectiles
- no more round reward choices (you get both)
- certain rounds in Planet 1 now have random enemy spawns
- performance improved when many effects on screen
- changes to player upgrades purchased with flaws:
[list]
[*] Cosmic Fate flaw upgrade double chance increased to 15% from 10%
[*] Extended Reach flaw upgrade range increased to 10% from 5%
[*] Wild Wrenches flaw upgrade rate per level increased to 2% from 1%
[*] all flaw upgrade costs lowered by varying amounts
[*] resetting your upgrades will refund all flaws you've spent before these changes
[/list]
- changed Healing Boost to now heal robot to full at the beginning of each round
- adjusted hack mod amount owned placement
- increased multi hack double attack chance to 5% from 3%
- increased area hack size to 5% from 3%, damage to 10% from 5%
- increased Stormcaller max level area damage to 15% from 10%
- increased Spellweaver max level slow damage per second to 15 from 10
- increased Exploder class effect to 10%/25% from 10%/20%
- increased Drill Reinforcement item health increase percentage to 25% from 20%
- decreased number of mines spawned by boss 2 and boss 3
- decreased number of baby crystals spawned by slime armor miniboss
- decreased the health of most enemies by varying amounts
- fixed "healing done" on victory screen to be more accurate
- fixed shielded robots able to be slimed
- fixed enemy burning state to be inflicted more reliably
- fixed Igniter ignite effect damage not being tracked in stats
- fixed victory screen robots' scaling to be more consistent with varying team sizes
- fixed team tracker number going off screen when team size in double digits using hd font

notes.title: Patch 1.015
notes.notes:
- armor miniboss in planet 2 cooldown times increased a bit

notes.title: The Laser Update - Version 1.014
notes.notes:
Hey Mechanibots, today's update includes a highly requested feature: attack markers for lasers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623014/fd72d70d77b66d7e7f172c687f4375c4c5cf6dd6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Better lasers for better lasering![/h3]

The laser attacks of the ice crystal enemies and the miniboss in Planet 2 are no longer unavoidable. They now display attack markers, giving you a chance to reposition your bots and Not Get Lasered. This brings these attacks in line with the behavior of other attacks in the game, creating a more consistent and reliable experience.

The full patch notes and details on other changes are down below. Thank you to everyone who provided the feedback for this update. As the only dev working on this project, your help is very appreciated!


[h3]And for the next update...[/h3]

In other news, I am hard at work on Mechanibot's first big update! As mentioned before, the main feature will be endless mode. Unlocked after beating the game, you'll be able to build larger and stronger teams than you'd be able to otherwise. In addition, gameplay will be much faster, with no pause between rounds. It gets pretty hectic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623014/f05b0dec72b062b4d40b43761c7ff2d73d042fae.jpg[/img]

[h3]Introducing the mechanic robot class[/h3]

We'll also be getting five new robots and an entirely new class! The mechanic robots will assist the Mechanibot with keeping the team nice and healthy. Some provide straight healing, while others are more about damage mitigation. I'm excited to see the builds people come up with these new bots.

All right, until next time, I gotta get back to work! Please share the game if you like it, and please consider writing a review! It helps me a lot. The Steam algorithm loves reviews.

[h3]Patch notes[/h3]
- ice crystal and slime miniboss lasers now use attack markers
- enemy laser attacks now travel full screen and hit all in path
- ice crystal cooldown increased
- slime crystal cooldown increased
- slime miniboss cooldowns increased
- adjustments made to the health values of all enemies (mostly reductions)
- save icon now appears in the top right corner of the screen when saving occurs
- hunter robot cooldown increased a little

notes.title: Patch 1.013
notes.notes:
- mouse size now scales inversely to window size
- fixed spike miniboss creating projectiles on death causing a rare crash
- fixed volcano boss creating attacks on death causing a rare crash
- fixed Windrunner's projectiles not consistently destroying when off screen
- fixed shield boost to work more reliably against big hits
- buying team boost no longer closes the store
- team boost now has a small chance to appear earlier in Planet 2

notes.title: ✨ Mechanibot is Out Now! ✨
notes.notes:
It's here!

[b][h2]Mechanibot is now available on Steam![/h2][/b]

[previewyoutube=BIRAzIxqulA;full][/previewyoutube]

Play as a small robot charged with repairing the dying sun. Build and upgrade your team of robots to survive against the waves of enemies keeping you from your goal. After an extremely dense six months of development, I'm super excited to finally share this world of robots with you.

It's just me on the team, so if you're able to do any of the following...
[list]
[*] Tell your friends
[*] Leave a review
[*] Share on social media
[/list]
...it'd be much appreciated!

[b][h3]I like that the game is out, but will you continue to update it?[/h3][/b]
Great question! After the whirlwind of release dies down and I find a moment to breath again, I'll begin work on Mechanibot's first big update, the Already Highly Asked For: [b]Endless Mode[/b].

[b][h3]Yeah, but what if I want to hear more from you?[/h3][/b]
Another great question, thank you for asking. Here's [url=https://twitter.com/encifer]my Twitter[/url], and here's where you can sign up for the [url=https://www.mechanibot.com/demo]mailing list[/url], where I'll send out any news about me and my games, advance notice of any sales or discounts, and sometimes even alpha/beta testing opportunities.

Okay, that's it! Keep your robots safe and have fun!

<3
Jon

notes.title: Robot Gallery Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Mechanibots, here we are again with another big update to the Mechanibot demo!

[b][h3]You Can Look at Your Robots![/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hd5j7J0.jpg[/img]

By popular demand, you can now view all of your robots in the new gallery! Conveniently found in a new room added to your base, you'll be able to check every robot's abilities, costs, and see if they're even unlocked yet.

You can even put them all in a pile and take screenshots (my favorite part).

[b][h3]A New Exploder Robot[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6FlujIc.gif[/img]

Cluster really likes throwing bombs. Like, REALLY, likes throwing bombs. It's obsessive. We're all okay with it though because of how many enemies we're constantly surrounded by. Cluster helps with that. Thanks, Cluster!

[b][h3]What Else is New?[/h3][/b]
As always, this update comes with many smaller updates, fixes, and features. Some of my favorites are:

- Certain legendary robots now unlocked by redeeming missions.
- Starting Capital upgrade now gives +2 starting gold per rank, up from +1.
- Hack Mods: stackable upgrades found as round rewards.
- More boss and NPC dialogue.
- So, so many balancing tweaks. Pretty much every number in the game is now a different number!
- Rare projectiles-forgetting-who-the-enemy-is crash fixed.

[b][h3]Until Next Time[/h3][/b]
It's just me working on Mechanibot and I wish I could work on it full time, but progress is going well and I'm very excited to finally share this huge demo update with you! Please feel free to use the in-game Feedback form to let me know what you think of the update and please consider wishlisting the game!

Thanks!
Jon

notes.title: Huge Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Mechanibots, I've been working hard on a huge update for the Mechanibot demo! Here's a quick overview of the biggest changes.

[b][h3]So, So Many New Robots[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/p4Ewera.gif[/img]

There's so many new robots that I lost count after twelve or so! Each class of robot now has at least four robots within that class, including high-level, legendary robots. (Which, it should be said, will need to be unlocked in the full game.)

Some of my favorite new robots include the Flameshot, whose arrows leave a trail of fire, the Laser, who creates small, short-lived helper bots with high attack speed, and the Berserker, whose attack damage is amplified by how high its health gets.

[b][h3]A New Player Ability[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QbJ6kpp.gif[/img]

The player now has access to the Magnet Pull ability! Using this, you can now pick up multiple robots at once! Perfect for getting your fragile dudes out of harm's way.

[b][h3]What Else is New?[/h3][/b]
I'm glad you asked because the answer is: SO MUCH. Here's some of the most notable smaller-but-still-extremely-important changes!

- New crystal crab enemy! Shoots waves of spikes that don't feel good on contact.
- Huge visual update. Robot and enemy colors unified to be more consistent and help with visual clarity.
- New background art for Planet 1.
- Tons of fixes and tweaks to help everything run more smoothly.

[b][h3]Until Next Time[/h3][/b]
It's just me working on Mechanibot and I wish I could work on it full time, but progress is going well and I'm very excited to finally share this huge demo update with you! Please feel free to use the in-game Feedback form to let me know what you think and please consider wishlisting the game!

Thanks!
Jon

notes.title: Robot Stats Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Mechanibots, the demo just received the [b]Robot Stats Update[/b]! 

The secret stats of all robots are no longer hidden from your view. Instead of guessing at the health and attack speed of your favorite Glowbot, that information is now available at a glance.

Additionally, upgrading your robots has gotten much more powerful. Each upgrade to a robot now increases that robot's max health and attack speed, up to a maximum of +30 and 5%, respectively.

Thank you to everyone who played and provided the feedback for these changes!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hbztnsz.jpg[/img]

Features
- Added robots' current max health and attack speed to their descriptions.
- Added robots' current health and attack speed indicators when out of combat.
- Added golden skins for robots at maximum level.

Tweaks & Fixes
- Some minor dialogue changes.
- More tips added to Tips Bot.
- Fixed miniboss death animation not playing correctly.
- Optimizations

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1842510/view/3091162528094751945]Check out yesterday's patch for more recent changes.[/url]

notes.title: Demo Patch
notes.notes:
Hey there Mechanibots, here's the details of a quick patch to the demo that just went live. Thank you to everyone who played and provided the feedback for these changes!

- Selling robots on accident resolved: holding the interact button for a second now required to sell.
- New dialogue hinting at the purpose of meta-progression currency when first found.
- When down to your last team member, wrenches now have an 80% chance to spawn as revive wrenches, up from 20%.
- Chain heal mod and remote wrench now heal the lowest health robots on your team based on their percentage health remaining, rather than flat health value.
- Rare crash on entering the base for the first time fixed.
- Boss having nothing to say fixed.
- Mechanibot movement sound effects nerfed.
